project.name: AgentForge Sentinel
project.repository_visibility_note: Recorded as private; do not promise public source access.
project.summary: Financial document insights and a synthetic investigation workbench with source evidence and human-approved simulated actions.

implemented.claim: Browser-local PDF, XLSX and DOCX review for supported financial layouts, with source-linked findings and cross-document comparisons.
Scoped case investigation, human approval, idempotent simulated execution and recorded audit/trace data.
Frozen synthetic ML evaluation and a registered histogram gradient boosting artifact; the hosted workbench defaults to rule scoring and deterministic investigation.
IAF retrieves curated project passages, optionally using OpenAI to select a permitted passage; it does not receive reviewed documents.

evidence.claim: 24 generated synthetic document files and 22 typed browser assertions across 14 scenarios.
evidence.scope: browser insights release; not fraud accuracy

evidence.claim: 1099 Windows and 1103 Ubuntu backend tests passed, plus one allowed live-provider skip per platform.
evidence.scope: historical AN01-M1 integration, not a current all-components badge

limitations: No established real-world fraud accuracy or financial loss prevention.
Synthetic workbench data and simulated actions; no bank integration.
Supported document layouts only; no OCR or authenticity verification.
Open security and dependency remediation recorded in the November 15 review.
No demonstrated customer-scale capacity or compliance certification.
Reporting measurements and live investigator quality evaluation remain incomplete.
